location.zh: 極光港機場的航空公司櫃檯

goal.en: Explain the delay, move to an earlier flight and ask for meal vouchers.
goal.zh: 說明班機延誤，改搭早一點的班機，再問有沒有餐券。

background: small airport check-in hall, airline counter with a baggage scale, rows of gray seats, large windows showing a runway and a parked plane, rainy gray sky, quiet afternoon

intro.en: Wednesday. A storm has damaged the railway, so every train to Maple Bay is canceled. You get a refund and book a short flight home instead.
intro.zh: 星期三。暴風雨弄壞了鐵路，往楓灣的火車全部停駛。你們拿到退票款，改訂一班短程班機回家。

intro.en: At the airport, the screen next to your flight says DELAYED.
intro.zh: 到了機場，螢幕上你們那班飛機旁邊寫著「延誤」。

intro.en: I have class tomorrow morning! Kai, can you talk to them?
intro.zh: 我明天一早有課！凱，你可以去問問嗎？

intro.en: Stay calm and be nice. That always works better.
intro.zh: 保持冷靜、客氣一點，這樣一定比較有用。

lines.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 午安。有什麼可以為您服務的嗎？

choices.en: Hi. Our flight to Maple Bay was delayed.
choices.zh: 你好。我們飛楓灣的班機延誤了。
choices.tip: 班機延誤用被動：Our flight was delayed.，先說出是哪一班，對方好查。

choices.en: Hi. We are delay. The flight to Maple Bay.
choices.zh: 你好。我們延誤了。飛楓灣的班機。

lines.en: You were delayed? So you missed your flight? I'm afraid there's a change fee for that.
lines.zh: 你們遲到了？所以錯過班機了？這樣恐怕要收改票費喔。

story.en: Ms. Carter starts charging you for missing a flight that hasn't left yet. It takes twenty minutes to sort out.
story.zh: 卡特小姐開始為你們「錯過」一班根本還沒起飛的飛機收費。花了二十分鐘才解釋清楚。

fail.why: We are delayed 會被聽成「我們自己遲到了」。延誤的是飛機，要說 Our flight was delayed.。

choices.en: Hi. Your airline ruined our whole day, you know.
choices.zh: 你好。你們航空公司毀了我們一整天，你知道嗎。

lines.en: I understand you're upset. Please take a seat, and I'll call you when I'm ready.
lines.zh: 我理解您不高興。請先坐一下，我準備好會叫您。

story.en: Ms. Carter helps five other passengers before she calls your name. Mia gives you a look that says, "I told you."
story.zh: 卡特小姐先幫了另外五位旅客，才叫到你的名字。米亞看你的眼神寫著：「我早就說了。」

fail.why: 延誤不是櫃檯人員的錯，一開口就抱怨只會讓對方不想幫你。先冷靜說明狀況：Our flight to Maple Bay was delayed.

lines.en: I'm so sorry. Flight 208 now leaves at nine p.m. That's a six-hour delay.
lines.zh: 非常抱歉。208 班機現在改為晚上九點起飛，延誤了六個小時。

choices.en: Oh no. Can we get on the next flight instead?
choices.zh: 糟糕。我們可以改搭下一班嗎？
choices.tip: 想改搭別班就說 Can we get on the next flight?，get on 是「搭上」交通工具。

choices.en: Oh no. Can we change to the next class?
choices.zh: 糟糕。我們可以換到下一班嗎？

lines.en: The next class? You'd like to upgrade to business class? That's three hundred dollars each.
lines.zh: 下一個艙等？您想升等商務艙嗎？每人三百元喔。

story.en: You now know exactly how much business class costs. You still leave at nine p.m., in economy.
story.zh: 你現在很清楚商務艙要多少錢了。你們還是晚上九點起飛，坐經濟艙。

fail.why: 「下一班」的「班」不是 class，class 在機場指艙等（economy、business）。要說 the next flight。

choices.en: Oh no. Is possible we changing to next flight?
choices.zh: 糟糕。有可能我們改到下一班嗎？

lines.en: Sorry, you're changing... what, exactly? Your seats? Your names?
lines.zh: 抱歉，您要改……什麼？座位？名字？

story.en: Ms. Carter carefully changes your seats to the window. You are still on the nine p.m. flight.
story.zh: 卡特小姐很仔細地把你們的座位換到窗邊。你們還是搭晚上九點那班。

fail.why: Is possible 少了主詞 it，we changing 也少了動詞。可以說 Is it possible to change to the next flight? 或 Can we get on the next flight?

lines.en: Let me check... Yes! The five o'clock flight has three seats left. You're on it.
lines.zh: 我查一下……有了！五點那班還剩三個位子，已經幫你們換好了。

lines.en: That's still a three-hour wait, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 不過恐怕還是要等三個小時。

choices.en: Thank you! Do we get meal vouchers for the wait?
choices.zh: 謝謝！等待期間有提供餐券嗎？
choices.tip: 班機延誤很久時，航空公司常提供 meal voucher（餐券），客氣地問就好。

choices.en: Three more hours? Then you owe us dinner, at least.
choices.zh: 還要三小時？那你們至少要請我們吃晚餐吧。

lines.en: We don't owe anyone dinner, but there are restaurants upstairs.
lines.zh: 我們沒有欠誰晚餐，不過樓上有餐廳。

story.en: You pay for an airport burger that costs as much as your train ticket. Leo eats it very slowly to make it worth it.
story.zh: 你們自己掏錢買了機場漢堡，價錢跟火車票差不多。里歐吃得超慢，想把錢吃回本。

fail.why: owe 是「欠」，用在這裡像在討債，對方就不想主動給了。客氣地問：Do we get meal vouchers for the wait?

choices.en: Thank you! Have any meal voucher can give us?
choices.zh: 謝謝！有沒有餐券可以給我們？

lines.en: Have any... do you mean, have I given you a voucher? Not yet, no.
lines.zh: 有沒有……您是說，我有沒有給過您餐券嗎？還沒有喔。

story.en: Ms. Carter answers your question perfectly and moves on to the next passenger. The vouchers stay in her drawer.
story.zh: 卡特小姐完美地回答了你的問題，接著去招呼下一位旅客。餐券還留在她的抽屜裡。

fail.why: 「有沒有……可以給我們」照中文字序直譯，英文聽不懂。要說 Do we get meal vouchers? 或 Are there any meal vouchers for the delay?

lines.en: Of course. Here are three vouchers, fifteen dollars each. Anything else I can help with?
lines.zh: 當然。這是三張餐券，每張十五元。還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.en: No, that's everything. You've been a big help!
choices.zh: 沒有了，就這些。你幫了大忙！
choices.tip: Anything else? 沒有其他事時說 No, that's everything.，再補一句感謝。

choices.en: Thanks so much! Here's ten dollars for your coffee.
choices.zh: 太感謝了！這十元給你買咖啡。

lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry, I can't accept that. We're not allowed to take money.
lines.zh: 喔，抱歉，我不能收。我們規定不能收錢。

story.en: Your ten dollars sits on the counter while everyone in line watches. You take it back very, very slowly.
story.zh: 你的十元就擺在櫃檯上，排隊的人全都看著。你非常非常緩慢地把錢收回來。

fail.why: 國外很多服務要給小費，但航空公司、機場櫃檯人員通常規定不能收錢。想表達謝意，說 You've been a big help! 就夠了。

choices.en: Yes, a chicken sandwich and a coffee, please.
choices.zh: 有，一份雞肉三明治和一杯咖啡，謝謝。

lines.en: I'm afraid I can't make sandwiches. The café is upstairs, though.
lines.zh: 恐怕我沒辦法做三明治耶。不過咖啡廳在樓上。

story.en: The people in line behind you start laughing. Leo pretends he doesn't know you all the way to the café.
story.zh: 後面排隊的人都笑了。去咖啡廳的一路上，里歐都假裝不認識你。

fail.why: Anything else I can help with? 是問「還有其他事要辦嗎」，不是在幫你點餐。沒事了就說 No, that's everything. Thank you!

lines.en: My pleasure. Enjoy your meal, and have a safe flight home.
lines.zh: 不客氣。祝用餐愉快，回程一路平安。

lines.en: Kai, you're a legend. I'll make it to class after all!
lines.zh: 凱，你太神了。我明天還是趕得上上課！

lines.en: See? Being nice works. Now, who wants dinner?
lines.zh: 看吧？客氣就有用。好，誰要吃晚餐？

story.en: Three hours, three free meals and one short flight later, you land in Maple Bay. Lost luggage, missed buses and a storm, and it was still the best trip ever.
story.zh: 三個小時、三份免費餐點和一趟短短的飛行之後，你們降落在楓灣。行李走失、錯過末班車又遇上暴風雨，這仍然是最棒的一趟旅行。

notes.explain: 延誤的是飛機，用被動語態 was delayed。說 I am delayed 會被聽成「我自己遲到了」。取消則是 was canceled。

example.en: Our flight was canceled because of the storm.
example.zh: 我們的班機因為暴風雨取消了。

notes.explain: 中文的「下一班」是 the next flight。class 在機場指艙等，例如 economy class（經濟艙）、business class（商務艙），說錯會被當成要升等。

example.en: Is there a seat on the next flight to Maple Bay?
example.zh: 下一班飛楓灣的班機還有位子嗎？

notes.en: Can we get on the next flight?
notes.zh: 我們可以改搭下一班嗎？
notes.explain: get on 是搭上公車、火車、飛機等交通工具。也可以說 Could you rebook us on an earlier flight?

example.en: Could you rebook me on an earlier flight?
example.zh: 可以幫我改到早一點的班機嗎？

notes.explain: 班機延誤較久時，航空公司常會發 meal voucher 讓旅客在機場用餐。客氣地問 Do we get meal vouchers? 就可以。

example.en: Excuse me, do we get meal vouchers for the delay?
example.zh: 不好意思，延誤有提供餐券嗎？

notes.explain: 餐廳服務生、計程車司機、導遊通常收小費，但航空公司、機場和政府櫃檯人員多半規定不能收錢。想道謝，真誠說一句 You've been a big help! 就夠了。

example.en: Thank you so much. You've been a big help!
example.zh: 非常謝謝你，你幫了大忙！
